findings.element: Shopify stores card, setup step "Set Created product to Inventory" (and the connect-first alert)
findings.finding: "Created product", "Non-inventory" and "Inventory" are unexplained, and nothing says what changing this Synder setting does to the rest of my syncing or to items already in QuickBooks.
findings.user_impact: Afraid of breaking my other syncs or my books, I leave the setting alone, the store stays "Setup needed", and sync never gets turned on for it.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one helper line under the step saying in plain words what the setting controls (the type of new products Synder creates in QuickBooks, so their stock can be tracked) and what it does not touch.

evidence.quote: Go to Settings › Products/Services and change Created product should be from Non-inventory to Inventory.

findings.element: Activity tab, Held row Reason column + "Retry 1 held" button
findings.finding: The reason "Item not matched" uses a different word from the Mappings tab ("Not mapped", "Unmapped only", "Map products") and does not say where to fix it, so Retry just answers "fix the reason first".
findings.user_impact: I click Retry, get told nothing was sent, and don't connect "not matched" with the Mappings tab, so the change stays stuck and I lose trust that stock is being kept in sync.
findings.suggested_fix: Word the reason with the Mappings term and point to the fix, e.g. "Not mapped to a Shopify product" with a "Map product" link that opens the Mappings tab on that item.

findings.finding: The dialog says it "writes the opposite adjustment in Shopify" but not whether QuickBooks changes too, nor that Shopify will then no longer match QuickBooks.
findings.user_impact: I hesitate over an action that looks permanent, unsure whether I'm undoing a bill in my books or creating a new stock mismatch I'll have to fix later.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one sentence: "QuickBooks isn't changed. Shopify will then differ from QuickBooks by 24 until the next stock check, where you can fix it."

evidence.quote: Push -24 back to the store? This writes the opposite adjustment in Shopify.

gaps: Failed Activity events: no Failed sample events exist, so the on-screen Reason text and Retry outcome for a Failed change could not be checked for clarity (only the tooltip copy was available).
Run now: prototype only toasts "Checked QuickBooks: 0 new changes.", so what a first-time user sees when changes are found was not reviewed.
Shopify install redirect: simulated by an in-page loader, so the real permission/approval screens a nervous user meets during Connect were not reviewed.
